description:
Change an open portfolio order. Use this before cancel_order.

    qty, price, expires_kind (day, gtc, or delete_after), expires_at, and
    after_hours. Send only the fields that change. Rules still apply. HIL on,
    or an order above Skip HIL up to, opens the accept card again. A day
    order needs an open session. A good till that lasts past the next open
    can stay open while the session is closed.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
        order_id: The order UUID
        qty: New share count
        price: New price, or the new limit
        expires_kind: day, gtc (90 days), or delete_after
        expires_at: Required with delete_after. Naive times are New York.
        after_hours: Extended session for a stock or ETF
name: edit_order
title: Edit portfolio order
